observations: The staged Warrior 198691 died at 14:34:46.771. Archer 198689 killed Thrax 198665 at 14:36:12.870, then died at 14:36:34.808. At 14:36:37.437 the player's rifle hit Thrax 198662 for 106, leaving 29 HP; Gunner 198688 dealt the final 22 damage at 14:36:37.540. Gunner died at 14:36:51.310.

The player's three 106-damage hits on Thrax 198661 at 14:37:20.833, 14:37:21.628 and 14:37:22.424 produced the player's first killing blow. The original client's chat showed 71 experience points and 10 credits. Shaman 198690 was still alive at this time; it died at 14:40:01.972.
With the weapon drawn, pressing R sent RequestWeaponReload at 14:42:34.732. The client display changed from 5/1000 to 20/985 loaded/reserve rounds after the reload completed.

The player hit Thrax 198664 through 75 armor and then health at 14:43:46-14:43:59, delivering the killing blow at 14:43:59.134. The client showed a second 71 XP and 10-credit reward. The stopped disposable database recorded 3713 XP and 330 credits, up from 3571 and 310.

After an attempted W+Space advance, area probes stopped at (295.8,120.5,70.6), 17.4 m from cave area 198602's center with a 10 m radius. Thrax 198663 killed the recruit there at 14:45:11.547. The client displayed the hospital selection dialog; mission tracker still read Capture the Flag / Find a way out of the cave.
limits: These are observations of the reconstructed emulator through the original client, not direct final-live proof for enemy health, armor, damage, allied survivability, rewards or combat pacing. The start was a copied checkpoint, the player paused frequently, and the cave objective was not entered. The remaining enemies and a complete normal-route fight still require verification against final-live evidence.
